intro_1_desc: Run an Altay server directly on Android to develop, test plugins and play on your local network.
intro_2_desc: Download the latest stable Altay release from the official releases and prepare the arm64 PHP runtime used by the app.
intro_3_desc: Use the console, files, plugins, worlds and usage statistics to monitor the server from your phone.
php_not_found_after_extract: PHP executable not found after extraction.
rar_not_supported: RAR files are not supported in this build without an additional library.
file_too_large: File is too large to edit here.
battery_message: To keep the server running for many hours, allow Android to ignore battery optimization for this app. This helps avoid interruptions while Altay is active.
terms_text: PocketHosting is provided by Vizy Solutions for local development and testing. You are responsible for your worlds, plugins, network access and server content. The app downloads Altay from its official releases and keeps the app's current PHP runtime. No account is required. Files are stored in the app-specific Android folder.

xbox_auth_desc: Verifies Microsoft/Xbox accounts. Experimental on Android; use Local/Offline to accept players with or without accounts.
auth_mode_note: Local/Offline mode accepts players with or without accounts, but does not validate Xbox identity. Xbox Live mode tries to validate through Microsoft services using an experimental local network bridge.
auth_online_toast: Xbox Live mode enabled. Restart the server to apply.
auth_offline_toast: Local/Offline mode enabled. Restart the server to apply.
dns_fix_message: For Xbox Auth to work on Android, the PHP runtime used by the app needs /sdcard/resolv.conf. The app will try to create it automatically when starting the server. On Android 11+, all-files access may be required for this fix.
dns_permission_needed: Allow file access so the app can create /sdcard/resolv.conf automatically.
dns_fix_failed: Could not apply the DNS fix automatically
dns_fix_message_required: Android blocked automatic creation of /sdcard/resolv.conf. For Xbox Auth to work with the PHP runtime used by the app, allow all-files access. Then return to the app: it will apply the fix and start the server automatically.
dns_fix_help: Having trouble joining your server? Tap the button below to apply the fix.
